plan.scope: I measure first source creations; I do not replace complete component/platform/release qualification.

process_observation.scope: I observe only actual factory descendants without wrapping or changing tools, inputs, cache keys, selections or deadlines. Observed presence is not exact CPU time; all original attempts remain separate evidence.

I record process presence within snapshot bounds, not exact CPU time. command_name is ps comm, not an independently resolved executable image. Observer ps costs remain included in child resource totals.
